subject: Post-discovery recap & pick a slot for the integration deep-dive
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Alex Ford <alex.ford@techforge.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 09 May 2028 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-discovery recap & pick a slot for the integration deep-dive

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our discovery so everyone has a single source of truth: 

- Goal: Evaluate Redwood Inference for customer-facing personalization pipeline (real-time embeddings + reranking).
- Primary constraints: 99th pct latency target < 120ms for 1k qps bursts, data residency for EU test subset (later phase).
- Important stakeholders to include next: Security (appsec / infra), Procurement, and Platform/Infra for SSO and network egress.

I've attached a short export of my notes (discovery-notes.pdf).

Next steps proposed: schedule a technical deep-dive (90 minutes) to walk architecture, data flows, and SSO/procurement requirements. Can you confirm one of these windows?

- Option A: Thu May 11, 2028 — 16:00–17:30 PT (Zoom link below)
- Option B: Fri May 12, 2028 — 09:00–10:30 PT

Please also loop in the security and procurement contacts so we can cover the questionnaire and evidence owners in the same meeting. If procurement prefers a shorter commercial sync later, we can keep them for just the first 30 minutes.

Zoom: https://zoom.us/j/1234567890

Thanks — looking forward.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Attachment: discovery-notes.pdf

Karthik —

Appreciate the clear recap. Option A (Thu May 11, 16:00 PT) works best for my team. I'm adding our security lead and procurement inbox below so they can join or delegate:

- Lisa Chang (Security) — lisa@techforge.com
- Procurement team — procurement@techforge.com

A couple of asks for the agenda if possible:
- High-level mapping of request/response times under load (want to see how batching affects p99).
- An outline of what evidence you can provide pre-meeting (SOC2 scope, network diagrams).

I'll confirm with procurement whether they want the full 90 minutes. If they opt out, they'll join the first 20–30 minutes.

Thanks, will wait for the official invite and agenda.

—Alex

Thanks Alex — good to hear. Looping in Priyom from our procurement/contract team so he's available if procurement wants to surface commercial questions during the call.

Proposed meeting agenda (90m):
1) 0–10m — Introductions, success criteria (Alex)
2) 10–35m — Architecture walkthrough (Karthik) — endpoints, auth, data flow, KV cache behavior
3) 35–60m — Load profile and p99 expectations; demo of batching effects (Karthik)
4) 60–75m — Security evidence & SSO/Network requirements (Marissa + Lisa invited)
5) 75–90m — Procurement / next steps (Priyom)

Attachments: technical-agenda.md (lightweight)

Two quick asks for prep from your side:
- Please confirm which SSO provider you'll want to test (Okta/SAML, AzureAD).
- If procurement prefers to only join at the end, tell us and we'll adjust the invite.

I'll send a calendar invite for Thu May 11, 16:00–17:30 PT with the Zoom link.

Cheers,
Karthik
